headline: Donkey Kong now runs on a fuse
lede: The arcade's bonus counter is back where it belongs: 5000 points ticking down from the moment the board lights, paid to you when you save her — and if it reaches zero, Donkey Kong takes Pauline and you lose a life.

notes.text: Shipped the timer-zero capture law (#3786, e63faf2): BONUS HUD counter, rescue banks the remainder (the flat 1000 lap fee is gone), zero arms a 90-tick grab — the ape lifts Pauline off her girder, a life pays, the board rebuilds with a fresh fuse.

kongcheck 174 green with a new bonus-timer section and a fleet floor that the proven route beats the fuse every lap (850 ticks of 3000); kongdrive 18/18 in real Chrome: countdown, live grab, life paid, fresh fuse, zero page errors.
Lesson banked: __game.step() locks the rAF clock until __game.release() — wall-clock assertions in browser drives must hand the loop back first.
The last honest gap (oil-drum flame kill) is now owned by QA pass #3796; the shelf is otherwise dry and the flagship question #3791 awaits Jon.
